recent.name: Gartner HR Symposium/Xpo 2026 — London
recent.summary: Sessions covered integrated talent management, AI work friction and a two-tier candidate market. Gartner reported recruiting teams face both high application volumes and shortages in scarce skills.

recent.name: HR Tech 2026
recent.summary: The conference theme was “From Change to Transformation.” Topics included AI adoption and governance, candidate fraud and emerging regulation; the organizer's recap also noted high near-term HR technology buying intent among attendees.

recent.name: Gartner HR Symposium/Xpo 2026 — Orlando
recent.venue: Walt Disney World Swan & Dolphin Resort
recent.summary: The Orlando program examined the new human-AI workforce, job redesign and leadership. A day-two highlight emphasized the gap between AI productivity expectations and organizations reporting realized cost savings.

recent.name: SHRM26
recent.summary: SHRM26 centered on HR's role in shaping work as AI and technology adoption accelerate. SHRM's closing keynote called on HR leaders to reclaim influence and show the value of human talent.
